description: Get a LOCKED design-token system for application UI (dashboards, admin panels, SaaS tools): every color role contrast-checked, exactly two radii, a five-step type scale, spacing, elevation and motion tokens, plus a Tailwind v4 semantic mapping, the theme's usage law, and the app-UI slop rulebook. This is how a vibe-coded app stops looking AI-generated: install the theme once and every view the agent builds matches. Call with NO theme to browse the menu (free); call with a theme id to receive the full system. Themes share brand DNA with the website directions, so a client's site and app stay on one identity.

response_format.description: Menu format when browsing: markdown (default) or JSON

theme.description: Theme id from the menu, e.g. graphite-ledger, terminal-grade-ui, porcelain-ui. Omit to browse the menu (unmetered).

name: get_app_theme
